scenario: LGRA.10.1.3: a `call` after `withdraw t` has an `on` body that reads `{t.v}`. The body runs when the response arrives, but its capture of `t` is taken when the `call` runs ([LCCO.5.2]), after the withdraw, so it reads a fact the withdraw removed. Refused with DS_VALIDATE_WITHDRAWN_BINDING_USED at the `call`. PATH PINNED: the check's walk into a continuation body nested in a later action; the `call`'s own arguments do not name `t`, so only the body can raise it. Twin: LGRA.10.1.3_call_body_reads_before_withdraw.
rules_ds:
schema NotifySendReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    status: Int

service notify.send:
    kwarg n: Int
    response NotifySendReply

schema Trig scope explicit:
    v: Int

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    withdraw t
    call notify.send n: 1 cooldown: 30_s
        on response.status == 200:
            log info "sent {t.v}"
